messages:
emma_support: hi @olivia, saw your ticket — can you paste the raw stream output you got?
olivia_customer: here's what we saw when resuming after auth refresh. final object never arrived, stream ended with 

data: {"choices":[{"delta":{...}}]}

(no finish_reason, no final chunk)
raj_sre: can you include the request-id from the initial call headers and whether you hit a proxy (eg, our infra or customer side)?
olivia_customer: req-id: r-93a2c, went through customer edge proxy -> akamai -> redwood prod. We reproduced in staging by forcing a token rotate mid-stream.
emma_support: repro steps? curl example?
olivia_customer: yes, curl like:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer OLD_TOKEN" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \n  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams?model=gptx" \n  --compressed
# then trigger token rotate on client, reconnect with NEW_TOKEN quickly
```
liam_eng: hypothesis: when backend switches auth context (token refresh) during reconnect, the proxy stalls the final SSE flush — last SSE chunk is swallowed. We're seeing missing terminal `{"finish_reason":...}` and sometimes a trailing comma.
raj_sre: can we get tcpdump/fastly logs? suspect keepalive + 302 auth handoff losing final frame.
emma_support: mitigation for customer: avoid immediate reconnect with new token for ~200ms, or enable client-side "wait-for-final" where client asks for finalization on reconnect.
liam_eng: we'll add logging around sse-terminate and auth-change; assigning eng-infra to investigate. @raj_sre can you attach fastly logs and any proxy response headers?
raj_sre: on it — will follow up with trace id trace-1719994321-01
deploy-bot: created ticket INF-4872 to track; priority P2.
emma_support: thanks all — @olivia, we'll keep you updated, request workaround in meantime: backoff 250ms on token rotate reconnects :thumbsup:
